svg.title: Figure 2 | Git locations and operations
svg.desc: Arrows show simplified operations: git add writes selected content to the index; git commit records the index as a commit. HEAD usually references the current branch tip; it is not a storage area.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: The files currently being edited, like a draft on your desk. Next:
git add selects content for the next version.
Selected content prepared for commit, like a delivery copy. Next: git
The repository stores history; HEAD usually references the current
branch tip, like the formally saved report version.
Arrows show simplified operations: git add writes selected content to
the index; git commit records the index as a commit. HEAD usually
references the current branch tip; it is not a storage area.
